description.value: AI-powered sales engagement platform covering lead finding, enrichment, multichannel outreach, and email deliverability.
An AI-powered sales engagement platform that finds leads and personalizes outreach.
Cold outreach and sales engagement platform; review sites describe it as a SaaS sales engagement and cold email automation platform.
Multichannel sales engagement platform; LinkedIn describes it as an AI platform for outbound sales.

product_description.value: Lead finding and enrichment (600M+ lead database, email finder and verifier, phone finder); multichannel sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, and SMS with a unified inbox; deliverability tools including lemwarm and a Deliverability Hub; AI agents; an MCP server and CLI; and 500+ integrations.
Reach leads via email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, and SMS, using the 600M+ lemlist database and smart filters to find accounts that match an ICP.

Personalized sequences with images, custom landing pages, and video prospecting; lemwarm warm-up tool; multichannel sequences covering email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and phone; and a lead database with verified contact details.

business_model_description.value: Subscription SaaS with a 14-day free trial and a demo request option; plan prices are not listed on the page. Every seat includes built-in deliverability tools.
SaaS subscriptions priced per seat; one review site lists $59 for email outreach and $99 for sales engagement, with a custom quote for an outbound agency tier.

customer_description.value: Sales reps, sales leaders, RevOps teams, and founders; 'sales and growth teams' including solo founders, agencies, and scaling teams. 20,000+ sales teams run outbound on the platform.
20,000+ sales teams; named customers include ElevenLabs, Pennylane, Spendesk, Mindee, RightMarket, and Devlo.
Sales teams of all sizes, startups, lead gen agencies, entrepreneurs, sales leaders, and RevOps professionals.

web_traffic.value: 20.4K estimated monthly organic visits (third-party tool, via Capterra)
